$comment: Root ADR-0348 (사장 결정 2026-10-30: the rt.molit.go.kr bulk path of FP-ADR-0020, its automation clause known; 2026-10-31: any hour, normal speed). How 국토교통부 실거래가 is asked from the 조건별 자료제공 export, how fast, and what stops a run. Read by collect-rt-molit-real-transaction (crates/publisher/foundation-publisher-collection/src/rt_molit_real_transaction_collect.rs, compiled in) and by the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/rt_molit_real_transaction.py). Checked 2026-10-30: no CAPTCHA and no login; a form page sets a session cookie, then a count check (JSON) and the CSV (POST); a nationwide export spans at most one month; no row cap (95,786 rows, 18 MB, 8 s).

manners.$comment: Root ADR-0348 §2 (사장 결정 2026-10-31: any hour, normal speed, practical safeguards). One session; up to `concurrency` exports in flight, each request after request_spacing_seconds; a busy answer (HTTP 429 or a 5xx) is asked again after a doubling backoff, `retry.attempts` times at most. The provider's own answer caps downloads at 100 a day (its count-check message, quoted in rt_molit_real_transaction_export_ingest.rs); 90 leaves room for people, and it is that daily cap, not the speed, that sets how fast the history fills.

refusal.$comment: Root ADR-0348 §3 (rt_molit_real_transaction_export_ingest.rs RtMolitRefusal and RtMolitBusy): an outright refusal (HTTP 403, or a page where JSON or CSV belongs: a block, notice, login or CAPTCHA page), or a busy answer that outlasts the retries, ends the run and fails it (the unit failure alert), and the collector waits (root ADR-0446, superseding the refused.json stop of ADR-0348 §6): after the n-th refusal in a row it waits manners.refusal_waits_seconds[n] (the last repeats), so a refusing provider is asked about once an hour, then every six hours, then once a day; a run inside the wait sends no request and ends with stopped_by refusal_wait; the first run after it asks again, and an export answered resets the count. Every refusal is appended to refusals.jsonl in the state directory. No file stops a run and no person clears anything; a refused.json left by the old collector is copied into that ledger once as legacy and never read.

refresh_budget_reason: Downloads a day (computed): the first tier 3 months x 12 datasets = 36, the second 10 x 12 / 7 = about 17, the third 12 x 12 / 30 = about 5: about 58 of the 90, leaving about 32 a day for the history (2,760 months: about 750 for the three industrial datasets first, about 23 days; all of it about 86 days). The provider's 100 a day bounds this, not our speed.

csv.$comment: Root ADR-0349. The export is CP949 text: a notice preamble, then a header line that starts with "NO", then one line per transaction. NO is a row number of this export, never identity. The mutable columns are filled in after the contract: a change in them is a new version of the same row.

place_inference.$comment: Root ADR-0351 (사장 결정 2026-10-31). Inferring the parcel of a masked lot, read by place_identity_resolver.enabled_levels / infer_masked. A level links a dataset's deals only when its `measured` precision for that dataset reaches precision_bar on at least min_measured_rows; a level not measured for a dataset is not used. Measured read-only 2026-10-31: API deals 2024-01..2025-12 (공장창고 every 시군구, 상업업무 80 시군구) and 2025-01..06 (토지, 단독다가구, ground truth: 40 시군구), candidates from ai-server Trino over silver.land_characteristic 20260519 and the current main buildings of silver.building_register_titles.
place_inference.ownership_causes_reason: Root ADR-0370, measured 2026-11-03 (read-only Trino, silver.land_ownership, 80,446,851 rows, base 2024-12): the file's 소유권변동원인 has no 매매; a sale is 소유권이전 (57,881,656 rows), beside 주소변경, 소유권보존, 성명(명칭)변경 and others. The file keeps each owner's last change only and is as of 2024-12, so a deal later than about 2024-09 cannot be confirmed by it and a parcel resold since the deal no longer shows the deal's change.
place_inference.precision_judged_on_reason: Root ADR-0370: a level is used when the low end of the 95% Wilson interval of its measured precision reaches precision_bar, not the point estimate.

levels.$comment: Root ADR-0405 (사장 결정 2026-11-04): the ownership level's evidence, but the link is to the 본번 필지 묶음 of the one parcel it leaves (every current parcel of that 법정동, 산 flag and 본번; place_identity_resolver.MAIN_LOT_GROUP), not to that parcel: the deal carries pnu_group and no pnu, and every parcel of the group shows it as 추정 · 같은 본번 with the others. evidence_checks.$comment: Root ADR-0370 §4 (2026-11-04, read-only): other evidence weighed for the ownership level, measured as the level is (agreement with the building register's one parcel on masked deals, 지분 excluded). None is used by enabled_levels: a check, not a level. `lot_group` scores a disagreement whose two parcels share the 본번 (300 and 300-1: one plant over two lots) as agreement, i.e. the precision of linking a deal to the 본번 필지 묶음 instead of one PNU; the owner turned it on as its own level, inferred_same_main_lot_group (root ADR-0405, 2026-11-04).

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load takes (plan-silver-load-objects): the Bronze objects no commit of silver.real_transaction records, within window_days, at most max_objects a load.
silver_load.per_run_reason: Root ADR-0300 H, measured 2026-10-31 (read-only Trino, silver.real_transaction$snapshots, 60 appending objects of the first loads): an object took p50 111 s, p90 165 s, max 206 s, and a run of up to 60 outlived the unit's 40-minute TimeoutStartSec every hour from 22:48 UTC. 9 objects at p90 plus about 3 minutes of Spark start and the one parcel read fit 30 minutes; run_time_budget_seconds stops starting objects at 30 minutes, leaving 10 for the object in flight (max 206 s) and the exit. 9 an hour is 216 a day against the collector's 90 downloads a day, so no backlog builds past window_days.
silver_load.max_rejected_share_reason: Root ADR-0364: an export's lines that are not loaded (a cell count not the header's, a NO that does not continue 1..N, a 계약년월 outside the export's month) land in silver.real_transaction_rejected with their Bronze object and line; the rest of the export loads. Above this share of an export's lines, or for an export refused whole (no header, another month in its preamble), the load fails after landing everything so it is seen. 2026-10-30: the 오피스텔 전월세 2026-10 export carried a second export's 14-column rows after its 13,180 own and stopped every load.
silver_load.max_unmasked_unresolved_share_reason: Root ADR-0349 §6: of the rows whose lot the provider did not mask, the share that found no current parcel; above it a load lands its rows and fails so it is seen. Measured 2026-10-30 before any load (2025-09, 12 random 시군구, read-only Trino against silver.parcel_boundaries current rows): 4,925 unmasked candidates of 공장창고·상업업무·아파트·연립·오피스텔, 99.7% a current parcel. History rows meet more re-numbered lots, so the bound leaves room; the pull request that records the first loads sets it from them.
silver_load.max_unmasked_unresolved_share_by_dataset: Root ADR-0469: the bound of a dataset whose rows name sites that are not current parcels yet. A 분양권·입주권 is sold before its complex's parcels exist: its 지번 is the lot before the site was re-plotted. Measured 2026-11-09 (read-only Trino, silver.real_transaction current rows, the block and provisional lots of ADR-0469 left out): 2026-09 322 of 1,776 lots (18.1%), 2026-10 355 of 1,640 (21.6%), 2026-11 so far 33 of 109 (30.3%), each a parcel_absent; every other dataset and month with 50 lots or more stays at or under 21.4% (commercial_trade 2026-10). 0.5 leaves the history months room and still fails a load whose linking broke (all of them unresolved).
